title: Tekken 5 / Dark Resurrection
tagline: The fifth King of Iron Fist Tournament returns.

source.label: Tekken 5: Dark Resurrection move and combo archive
source.note: Commands use 1/2/3/4 notation. Tekken 5 and Dark Resurrection share this archive, but move properties and combo timing can differ between versions. 10 hit combos are preset strings, not guaranteed juggles.

portraits.credit: Original character artwork: Namco / Bandai Namco.
